### ✨ MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline Mod Menu (v1.00.01)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Infinite Health / HP & Vitality** — Locks player HP & prevents incoming health loss
- **Unlimited Energy & Stamina (999 + 0 Cost)** — Locks weapon energy/stamina at 999 with zero consumption
- **Damage & Reward Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Scales player outgoing attack via GetFinalATK (1x - 100x)
- **Unlimited Coins & Gold** — Sets Coins/Zenny balance to 9,999+ and never decreases
- **Unlimited Gems / Elemental Metal** — Sets Elemental Metal & Cash to 9,999+ with free shop purchases
- **Instant Unlimited Hints & No Cooldown** — Removes skill & stage action cooldown timers
- **Unlimited Stars, Score & XP Rewards** — Maximizes mission stars, score & experience rewards
- **Check Hook & Patch Status** — Verifies base address, active hooks & live memory patches

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
